llm.summary: The pick underperformed and ended as dead money under a clean process, with mixed causal attribution. The close resemblance to the other utility case suggests a sector or regime hypothesis, but the supplied records alone cannot establish common causation.
llm.root_cause: The pick underperformed and ended as dead money under a clean process, with mixed causal attribution. The close resemblance to the other utility case suggests a sector or regime hypothesis, but the supplied records alone cannot establish common causation.
llm.lesson: The buy book encountered a non-expressive utility setup, while regime-cell, sector-rotation, and path-efficiency engines may have missed a shared adverse environment.
llm.engines_credit: Regime and utility-rotation books are the leading laggard hypotheses; company-alpha attribution remains unresolved, and no role model is established.

causal_chain.mechanism: The prevailing macro environment may have been unfavorable for utility relative performance.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Utility weakness persisting after macro controls would favor sector-specific or company-specific explanations.

causal_chain.mechanism: A shared utility-sector headwind may have suppressed relative returns across more than one pick.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Strong utility-sector performance would contradict a broad sector explanation.
evidence_refs: another utility pick in the same cycle also underperformed and ended DEAD_MONEY

causal_chain.mechanism: The expected move did not materialize within the observed horizon, producing dead money.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Conditioning the expected thesis horizon on utility regime could have clarified whether delayed expression was normal or anomalous.

alternate_explanations: Company-specific regulatory exposure drove the result.
A risk-on market penalized defensive relative returns without damaging the absolute thesis.
The audit horizon ended before a legitimate long-duration thesis matured.
missing_evidence: Interest-rate and risk-regime data at entry

signal_hypotheses.measurement: Decompose same-cycle utility outcomes into market, utility-sector, peer-group, and company residual components using entry-time classifications.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: A dominant common component would support sector or regime conditioning.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Company residuals dominate and differ materially across utility picks.
